data.name: Aniceta
data.gender_notes: Aniceta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin anicetus, meaning 'gracious, merciful'. In Christian tradition, Aniceta is the name of a female martyr who lived during the reign of Emperor Nero. The name Aniceta carries the meaning “Gracious, Merciful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Aniceta usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aniceta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Merciful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aniceta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אניצטה
in_hebrew.meaning: אל grace, חיה - חסד נצחי, חיה ברוכה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אניצטה מורכב משתי שורשים עבריים: 'אל' ו'חיה'. הוא מתאר אדם עם חסד אלוהי נצחי וחיים ברוכים. השם קשור למסורת הנוצרית ולשורשים העבריים של השפה היוונית והלטינית המשמשות בנצרות.

in_greek.name: Ανικετα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ανικετα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'ανίκητος', που σημαίνει 'ακατάβλητος' ή 'απερίγραπτος'. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με τη χάρις (χάριν) του Θεού και την πνευματική της σημασία στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Aniceta
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aniceta derivatur ex Latinis verbis 'in vincibilis' et 'gratia'. Significat personam quae est gratia Dei insignis, misericordia et benignitate praedita. Nomen hoc usitatum est in traditione Christiana.

in_english.name: Aniceta
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aniceta originates from Greek and Latin roots, signifying 'unconquerable' or 'invincible'. It is associated with divine grace, mercy, and kindness. Historically, the name reflects the Christian virtues of resilience, compassion, and spiritual strength. Aniceta is a name that embodies the Christian values of faith, hope, and charity.

data.cultural_impact: Aniceta is a name that evokes a sense of kindness, compassion, and generosity. It is a reminder of the Christian values of mercy and grace, which were particularly important during times of persecution. The name Aniceta is a tribute to Saint Aniceta, who was martyred for her faith, symbolizing the valuable legacy of Christian martyrs who lived and died for their beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: To bear the name Aniceta is to carry with you a sacred trust, a call to emulate the gracious and merciful spirit of the Christian martyr. It is a reminder to be merciful towards others, to show compassion and grace, and to live a life that reflects the love and forgiveness at the heart of the Christian faith. In bearing this name, one is invited to live a life of selflessness, kindness, and grace, in imitation of the saint whose life and martyrdom continue to inspire and challenge us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aniceta: From the Latin word "anicitas," meaning friendship or goodwill. In Christianity, this name symbolizes the deep and unending love and companionship between God and his people. It is a reminder of the friendship that is offered to us through Christ's sacrifice.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aniceta remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
